title: Final Simulation
description: Combine introduction, technical evidence and a clear closing.
scenario: You have a final conversation with an international hiring panel.
initial_question: Introduce yourself, highlight one technical achievement and explain what you want next.
transfer_question: What unique contribution would you bring to this international team?
language_policy: Tutor speaks concise English and accepts English learner responses.
correction_policy: Select one primary and at most one distinct secondary correction.
completion_rules: First attempt, retry, transfer, evidence, summary and review.
prompt_context: Treat this as a concise final simulation and keep the learner in control.
